ai.title: AI recommendation
ai.clapDetail: Using CLAP (laion/clap-htsat-fused, 512-dim). Requires the audio-embedder sidecar to be running.
ai.mfccDetail: Using legacy MFCC (32-dim). No Python sidecar needed.
ai.description: Powers for-you playlists with the local CLAP audio model (~1 GB resident, runs in a Python sidecar). Disable on light servers to fall back to the previous engine (32-dim MFCC embeddings via ffmpeg, tag-driven ranker). Playlists are recomputed on the next regeneration in either case.
ai.note: Note: disabling requires ffmpeg on PATH for the MFCC backfill. Until backfill completes, embedding similarity is treated as neutral and playlists are picked from genre + year + popularity signals only.
ai.enabledMessage: AI recommendation enabled. New uploads will use CLAP; existing tracks will be re-embedded in the background.
ai.disabledMessage: AI recommendation disabled. The Python sidecar is no longer required; for-you reverts to the legacy MFCC engine.
